control.name: Access Control — Standard
control.description: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain electronic protected health information to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights.
sub_controls: HIPAA.164.312.a.2.i   [required]   Unique user identification — Assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.
HIPAA.164.312.a.2.ii  [required]   Emergency access procedure — Establish (and implement as needed) procedures for obtaining necessary electronic protected health information during an emergency.
HIPAA.164.312.a.2.iii [addressable] Automatic logoff — Implement electronic procedures that terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity.
HIPAA.164.312.a.2.iv  [addressable] Encryption and decryption — Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information.

control.name: Transmission Security — Standard
control.description: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.
sub_controls: HIPAA.164.312.e.2.i  [addressable] Integrity controls — Implement security measures to ensure that electronically transmitted ePHI is not improperly modified without detection until disposed of.
HIPAA.164.312.e.2.ii [addressable] Encryption — Implement a mechanism to encrypt electronic protected health information whenever deemed appropriate.
